::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Jany 19th 1874  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS British Library Add MSS 54921: 1-2
:::

Dear [Mr Macmillan](people/person_939.qmd)
I am trying the abridging process upon [Bishop Patteson](cmy_books/cmybook_102.qmd), but I hope the latter part can wait to be reprinted till I get the corrections from the Mission itself.

I am much afraid that [Lady Martin](people/person_970.qmd)’s recollections about New Zealand, about which I wrote to you have been lost on the voyage. They were announced, and enquired after, but never appeared 

I see the third volume of the [Scripture Readings](cmy_books/cmybook_87.qmd) must stop with Daniel’s last chapter. I think I can make the 4th and last get to the end of the Acts as there is much less collateral matter to lengthen out with, and to harmonise a narrative from the Gospels is more desirable than to give <u>every</u> discourse. But I must begin from the return from captivity

Yours sincerely
C M Yonge

---

**Note:** For the biography of Bishop Patteson.
